{"hypotheses": [ 
    {"name": "Hypothesis_1", 
     "mechanism": "Leverage amplifies the impact of changes in Asset Growth, making companies with higher leverage more sensitive to changes in Asset Growth, leading to higher returns.", 
     "expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "AssetGrowth"}, {"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "Beta"}], 
                    "regime": "VIX_ABOVE_TRAILING_MEDIAN", 
                    "vol_target": true}, 
     "auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "VIX_ABOVE_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "direction": "higher"}, 
                              {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "small", "direction": "stronger"}, 
                              {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "Beta", "bound": "above", "threshold": 0.3}], 
     "expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.5, 
     "expected_decay_half_life_months": 24},

   {"name": "Hypothesis_2", 
     "mechanism": "Market overreaction to short term reversal stocks can lead to long term reversal, witnessed in stocks with high Bid-Ask spread and volatility.", 
     "expression": {"terms": [{"weight": -1.0, "primitive": "STreversal"}, {"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "BidAskSpread"}, {"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "VolSD"}], 
                    "regime": "VIX_BELOW_TRAILING_MEDIAN", 
                    "vol_target": true}, 
     "auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "VIX_BELOW_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "direction": "higher"}, 
                              {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "small", "direction": "stronger"}, 
                              {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "VolSD", "bound": "above", "threshold": 0.3}], 
     "expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.6, 
     "expected_decay_half_life_months": 24},

    {"name": "Hypothesis_3", 
     "mechanism": "Firms with high R&D investment are more likely to experience earnings surprise due to unexpected innovation outcomes.", 
     "expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "RD"}, {"weight": -1.0, "primitive": "EarningsSurprise"}], 
                    "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_UP", 
                    "vol_target": true}, 
     "auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_UP", "direction": "higher"}, 
                              {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "small", "direction": "stronger"}, 
                              {"type": "international", "region": "emerging", "direction": "same_sign"}], 
     "expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.4, 
     "expected_decay_half_life_months": 30},

    {"name": "Hypothesis_4", 
     "mechanism": "Firms in high Herfindahl index industries can sustain high profit margins due to low competition, leading to higher returns.", 
     "expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "Herf"}, {"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "BM"}], 
                    "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_POSITIVE", 
                    "vol_target": true}, 
     "auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_POSITIVE", "direction": "higher"}, 
                              {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "micro", "direction": "stronger"}, 
                              {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "Herf", "bound": "above", "threshold": 0.3}], 
     "expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.7, 
     "expected_decay_half_life_months": 18},

    {"name": "Hypothesis_5", 
     "mechanism": "Firms with high Intangible returns using CFtoP and low Short Interest are likely to have sustainable business models leading to higher returns.", 
     "expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "IntanCFP"}, {"weight": -1.0, "primitive": "ShortInterest"}], 
                    "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_NEGATIVE", 
                    "vol_target": true}, 
     "auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_NEGATIVE", "direction": "higher"}, 
                              {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "large", "direction": "stronger"}, 
                              {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "ShortInterest", "bound": "below", "threshold": 0.3}], 
     "expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.6, 
     "expected_decay_half_life_months": 24},

    {"name": "Hypothesis_6", 
     "mechanism": "Firms with high employee growth hire and have strong momentum, leading to higher returns.", 
     "expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "hire"}, {"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "Mom6m"}], 
                    "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_DOWN", 
                    "vol_target": true}, 
     "auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_DOWN", "direction": "higher"}, 
                              {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "large", "direction": "weaker"}, 
                              {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "hire", "bound": "above", "threshold": 0.3}], 
     "expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.5, 
     "expected_decay_half_life_months": 18},

    {"name": "Hypothesis_7", 
     "mechanism": "Firms with high Citations to R&D expenses are likely to have superior innovation leading to higher returns.", 
     "expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "CitationsRD"}, {"weight": -1.0, "primitive": "ShareIss5Y"}], 
                    "regime": null, 
                    "vol_target": true}, 
     "auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "size_segment", "segment": "small", "direction": "stronger"}, 
                              {"type": "international", "region": "developed_ex_us", "direction": "same_sign"}, 
                              {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "CitationsRD", "bound": "above", "threshold": 0.3}], 
     "expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.6, 
     "expected_decay_half_life_months": 24},

    {"name": "Hypothesis_8", 
     "mechanism": "A positive change in net operating assets can lead to higher returns as it signals a healthy change in the operations of the firm.", 
     "expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "ChNNCOA"}, {"weight": -1.0, "primitive": "TotalAccruals"}], 
                    "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_UP", 
                    "vol_target": true}, 
     "auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_UP", "direction": "higher"}, 
                              {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "mega", "direction": "weaker"}, 
                              {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "ChNNCOA", "bound": "above", "threshold": 0.3}], 
     "expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.6, 
     "expected_decay_half_life_months": 24}
]}
